method: Four isolated serial source runs in AB/BA order, identical 235 registered cases, 31 warm poses, 121 uniform forward samples plus stage and irregular reverse poses per case. Arithmetic mean of the two runs per version. Repeated identical poses are reported separately and are not used as active playback benefit. Structure times are build/worker packing and main-thread unpack/presentation only, six runs per root and version; full browser readiness measured independently. No FPS or cross-device claims.
